title: Bracket random vibration
line: A random vibration FEA study of a steel bracket under a 14.2 g RMS base PSD.
description: Random vibration of a steel wall-hook bracket (40 x 50 x 35 mm) bolted at its three mounting holes. The mounting is shaken along the wall by a 20 to 2000 Hz base-acceleration PSD shaped like a component qualification profile (14.2 g RMS), with 3% modal damping. The study returns RMS displacement and RMS von Mises stress.
thumbnailAlt: RMS displacement of a steel bracket under random base vibration, solved in RunMat
